label: configurator • "Read <SKILL.md link> and set it up" goes to osaurus_import with the link
query: Read https://tempo.xyz/SKILL.md and set up tempo
notes: Universal chat import, the motivating example. The Configurator passes the link to osaurus_import (code fetches it) rather than reading the page with web tools or writing a skill by hand. The selection assertion pins the link; the fetch itself depends on the network, so the rubric accepts an honest failure report.

rubric: Reports what the tool result says (the Tempo skill was added, or why it could not be fetched) in one or two sentences, without inventing skill contents.
